method: 5 perspective-diverse independent reviewers (re-derivation, alt-deconfounded-rankers, metric-interpretation, leak-validity, steelman-opposite) re-derived every headline number from the exported 8041-candidate/31-task table incl. the (8041,512) z_mean latents (no GPU) + 1 synthesis. ~300 alternative OOF/LOTO constructions swept across the panel. Workflow gap3-stage1-adversarial-verify (run wf_9e08f12d-375).

reviewer_verdicts.best_alt_ranker_found: LOTO kNN-5 to train-gold latents on unit-normalized z_mean (vote-free construction): pass@2=0.4516 — TIES vote, does not beat it; VOTE-CONFOUNDED (corr with log-votes -0.36; within-task residualization collapses it to pass@2=0.0968; 13 of its 14 top-2 hits are vote's own hits)
reviewer_verdicts.notes: Every committed number re-derived exactly from the npz: vote 0.4194/0.4516 (13,14 of 31), probe 0.2903/0.4194, Q_MEAN 0.2903/0.2903, residual 0.0323/0.0645, HYBRID 0.4194/0.4516, oracle 19/31=0.6129, within-task AUROC 0.8689 (18 tasks), bootstrap CI [-0.129,0.0645] reproduced both via the committed LCG and an independent numpy B=10000 bootstrap, headroom -0.1996. Probe column independently refit twice (exact-SVD replication + eigh-Gram): max|diff|=5.1e-07, Spearman 1.000000, identical pass@K — fully reproducible. Attacks that FAILED to refute: (a) fairer deconfounds than committed (within-task residual 0.0968, rank-based 0.129, log-vote 0.0645) all far below vote; (b) PCA-K sweep K=4/8/12/24/48/96 all probe pass@2<=0.4194 and residual<=0.0968 (K=192 timed out under sibling CPU contention; pattern overdetermined); (c) vote-free LOTO gold-centroid and kNN-5 energies at best TIE 0.4516 and collapse under residual. NEW findings that STRENGTHEN the negative: votes itself has within-task AUROC 0.9235 > probe 0.8689, and the vote-orthogonal probe residual has AUROC 0.3176 (below chance) — the latent carries NO incremental gold signal beyond vote; mechanism: corr(||z_mean||, log1p(votes))=-0.80 because per-candidate mean-pooling over augmentations bakes vote count into the feature. HYBRID no-gain is non-vacuous (the single tie-break opportunity, c3202e5a, was genuinely failed: gold probe 0.6443 vs non-gold 0.5420). Minor issues only: 'signal EXISTS' framing overstates (it is a pure vote shadow); bootstrap point -0.0322 computed from pre-rounded values (exact -0.0323); CI upper bound +0.0645 means n=31 cannot exclude a small positive (already disclosed; re-confirm at 400 per artifact). Stage-2 recommendation: compute energy from grid content generator-independently and avoid augmentation pooling (structural vote leak).

reviewer_verdicts.best_alt_ranker_found: raw512_logit_l2_1 (LOTO, standardized raw 512-d latent + class-balanced L2 logistic, no PCA): pass@2=0.4516 — a TIE with vote, never a beat. It is VOTE-CONFOUNDED: residualized over votes its pass@2 collapses to 0.1613 (linear) / 0.2903 (log-vote), and its bootstrap-over-tasks pass@2 delta vs vote is +0.0000 with CI95=[-0.0968,+0.0968]. The same tie-and-collapse pattern holds for the whole 0.4516 tie cluster (lda_shrunk, knn5-dist-to-train-gold eucl+cos, gold_centroid_eucl, softmin-to-gold, vote-weighted-centroid — the last vote-using by construction). Zero of 30+ alternative rankers exceeded 0.4516.
reviewer_verdicts.notes: RE-DERIVATION (from results/arc3_gap3_stage1_candidate_table.npz, n=31 tasks / 8041 candidates, /tmp/gap3v/verify_committed.py): every committed headline number reproduced EXACTLY — vote 0.4194/0.4516, probe 0.2903/0.4194, probe-residual 0.0645, Q_MEAN 0.2903, HYBRID 0.4516, oracle 19/31=0.6129, within-task AUROC 0.8689 (18 scoreable tasks), bootstrap point -0.0322 CI95 [-0.129,0.0645] (exact LCG replication), headroom_capture -0.1996. The committed probe column itself re-fits from raw z_mean (LOTO PCA-24 + balanced logistic) to max|diff|=5.1e-7 — the implementation does what it claims. npz/JSON-sidecar provenance spot-check aligned. ALT-RANKER SWEEP (all LOTO where labels used; /tmp/gap3v/lean_sweep.py + extra_rankers.py + ranknet.py): PCA-k logistic k∈{4,8,12,24,48,96} → 0.3871-0.4194; raw-512 logistic L2∈{1,10,100} → 0.4516 tie; kNN-dist-to-train-gold k∈{1,5,18} eucl+cos, raw+per-task-z features → ≤0.4516; gold-centroid eucl 0.4516 / cos 0.4194; Mahalanobis-shrunk 0.3871; LDA-shrunk 0.4516 tie; GBM stumps (exact best-split) on PCA-24 → 0.3548; RankNet within-task pairwise ranking loss k∈{8,24,64} → 0.2581-0.3548; per-task-centered logistic → 0.3871-0.4194; softmin-to-gold 0.4516 tie; unsupervised: local-density-k5 0.0645, PCA-recon-err 0.2258/0.3871, dist-unweighted-centroid 0.0323, dist-vote-weighted-centroid 0.4516 (vote-using by construction). Per-task z-scored probe is analytically identical to the probe (monotonic within-task). EVERY tie collapses under vote-residualization (to 0.06-0.29) — no vote-orthogonal signal converts to selection. STRUCTURAL DIAGNOSIS of why the negative is robust: vote already wins 14/31 (13 rank-1, 1 rank-2); headroom is exactly 5 tasks (gold vote-rank 65/7/3/3/5). On the two large-pool headroom tasks the gold is even MORE latent-buried than vote-buried (task 2: latent ranks 252-442 of 599 vs vote 65; task 22: 18-69 of 754 vs vote 3); only task 29 is latent-recoverable (rank 2-3), and capturing it always costs ≥1 vote-won task (probe drops tasks 21+27 to rank 4; knn5 drops task 13) — net ≤0. Mechanistic confound: train-fold gold latents have votes 700-1000 (median ~744) and z_mean is the mean over `votes` augmentation latents, so ||z_mean|| correlates -0.41 (Spearman) with votes — gold-proximity geometry partially proxies vote count itself, which is why all ties evaporate under residualization. CAVEATS (do not change the verdict): n=31 is small (committed CI95 upper edge +0.0645 includes 0 — "does not beat" is supported, "provably worse" is not); ~30 rankers tried with ZERO nominal winners strengthens the negative against multiple-comparisons luck; substrate independence is partial — I re-derived from the committed run's own latent table (provenance-verified), not from a fresh TRM latent dump (GPU off-limits per instructions). Files: /tmp/gap3v/{verify_committed,lean_sweep,extra_rankers,ranknet,deep_dive}.py, /tmp/gap3v/lean_results.json, score_*.npy.

reviewer_verdicts.best_alt_ranker_found: probe24+knn25 within-task rank-average (vote-free LOTO latent combo): pass@2=0.4839 (+1 task t29, gold rank 3->2, zero losses) vs vote 0.4516 — but VOTE-CONFOUNDED per the committed rule (residual-over-votes pass@2 collapses to 0.0323), bootstrap CI95 [+0.0000,+0.0968] with 36.7% of resamples <=0, and post-hoc selected from ~16 tries. reviewer_verdicts.lens: METRIC-INTERPRETATION: recomputed every headline metric from the 8041-candidate NPZ (AUROC weighting/hard-negative variants, MRR/gold-rank, task-bootstrap CI, headroom confusion matrix, tie-break sensitivity, capped-eval vote-noise quantification) + strict-LOTO vote-free alt-ranker sweep
reviewer_verdicts.notes: All committed numbers replicate exactly (vote 0.4194/0.4516, probe 0.2903/0.4194, residual 0.0645, oracle 0.6129, AUROC 0.8689, CI [-0.129,0.0645]); committed probe column reproduces from scratch (corr=1.0). MINOR metric-honesty finding that STRENGTHENS the negative: the 0.8689 AUROC is macro over only 18 tasks and inflated by 84.6% one-vote junk negatives — pair-weighted 0.7815, hard-negatives(top-10-by-vote) 0.7948, negatives with votes>=5 0.6646 (BELOW the 0.70 gate); VOTE's own within-task AUROC is 0.9235 > probe, so 'signal exists but does not convert' over-credits the latent. Probe MRR 0.3797 vs vote 0.4685; on the 5 recoverable tasks the probe WORSENS gold rank in 4/5 (t2 65->329, t22 3->62) and demotes a 903/1001-vote gold to rank 4 (t21). headroom_capture -0.1996 arithmetic correct; anatomy: 5 recoverable, probe recovers 1 (t29), loses 2 (t21,t27), net -1 task. Bootstrap sound (tasks resampled; LCG replicated bit-exact; numpy B=20k identical); n=31 underpowered to show probe WORSE (sign test 1W/2L p=1.0) — only that it fails to beat. Tie-break hides nothing: probe-alone identical; vote baseline slightly UNDERSTATED by stable-order ties (random-tie mean 0.4698) and HYBRID's one decisive tie-break (t22, two 15-vote cands) was called WRONG by the probe — both biases favor the probe and it still lost. Partial-vote caveat resolved: 23/31 tasks have FULL 1001-aug coverage; thinning votes to 25% leaves vote pass@2 ~0.460 — vote noise is immaterial and the cap biases FOR the probe, so the negative is conservative. Recommend: (1) corrigendum note that the discrimination gate fails (0.66) against votes>=5 negatives and that vote AUROC 0.9235 exceeds the probe's; (2) carry probe+knn25 rank-avg as a cheap steelman arm in the 400-task re-confirmation. Files: /tmp/gap3_stage1_metric_audit.py, /tmp/gap3_stage1_audit2.py, /tmp/gap3_stage1_altrankers.py, /tmp/gap3_stage1_combo_adjudicate.py.

reviewer_verdicts.best_alt_ranker_found: probe_k192 (OOF LOTO PCA-192 + balanced L2 logistic, pure-latent) and lda_k24 both reach pass@2=0.4839 (15/31), +1 task over vote's 0.4516 (14/31). Both are VOTE-CONFOUNDED per the stated rule: residualized-over-votes their pass@2 collapses to 0.1290/0.1613 (per-fold residualization, no leak). The +1 lift is a single task (t29, gold at vote-rank 2), bootstrap CI95 over tasks = [+0.0000, +0.0968] with frac(delta<=0)=0.349, found via a ~16-variant search (probe K=8/16/24/32/48/96 all stuck at 0.4194 — K=192 is a single-K spike; lda_k96 falls back to a tie), and 0.4839 does not even exceed VOTE's own optimistic tie-break ceiling (0.4516 pessimistic / 0.4839 optimistic). Not a refutation.
reviewer_verdicts.notes: ALL committed headline numbers re-derived exactly from the npz: VOTE 0.4194/0.4516, LATENT_PROBE 0.2903/0.4194, Q_MEAN 0.2903/0.2903, residual 0.0323/0.0645, HYBRID 0.4194/0.4516, oracle 19/31=0.6129, within-task AUROC 0.8689 (18 folds), bootstrap delta -0.0323 CI95 [-0.129,+0.0645], headroom_capture -0.1996. Committed probe column reproduces from z_mean via the documented protocol to max|diff|=5.1e-7 with per-task rank agreement 1.0. LENS FINDINGS: (a) PCA basis fit on train-fold candidates only (code lines 177-184) — verified by exact numerical reproduction; NO leak. (b) Held-out gold labels never reach the fold's probe fit (ytr from train_cands only) — but ONE minor validity issue: the LOTO is leave-one-ENTRY-out, and task f3e62deb contributes TWO entries (t29/t30) that sit in each other's training folds (a sibling leak, direction favors the probe — t29 is the probe's only win-vs-vote). Empirically immaterial: strict grouped LOTO (siblings held out together) gives identical probe pass@2=0.4194 and identical gold ranks (t29=1, t30=7). Severity minor; conservative for the negative. (c) Global residualization is transductive (one OLS over all 8041) but label-free; per-fold (LOTO) residualization gives IDENTICAL pass@1/2 = 0.0323/0.0645 — a control, not a leak; conclusion unchanged. Caveat: residual-ranking is structurally anti-vote (harsh control), but nothing hinges on it since the probe loses to vote outright. (d) Washout confound REFUTED: corr(||z_mean-mu||, log votes) = -0.014 (mean-pooling does not inject vote count into the latent); no gold candidate is singleton-vote (0/19); restricting ranking to votes>=2 pool only TIES vote (0.4516); unit-norm probe unchanged (0.4194); train-filter votes>=2 makes it WORSE (0.3548). The deeper reason the negative holds: vote's own within-task AUROC (0.9235) EXCEEDS the probe's (0.8689) — the latent is a strictly weaker discriminator; on the 5 vote-miss tasks gold sits at votes {2,3,15,5,29} among up to 754 candidates and the probe ranks gold WORSE than vote on 4 of 5 (e.g., 328 vs 64; 61 vs 2). (e) Candidate identity verified: 31 task entries, 8041 candidates; votes/q_mean/correct multisets match Stage-0's sidecar exactly per entry (after correctly handling the duplicated f3e62deb name; an apparent mismatch was my own grouping bug). Tie-handling: stable-sort puts VOTE at its PESSIMISTIC tie-bound (0.4516; optimistic 0.4839) — the baseline is not tie-inflated. Alt-ranker sweep (16 de-confounded OOF variants: probe K=8..192, LDA, Mahalanobis-to-gold, kNN-25, probe+q_mean stack, unit-norm, task-centered, train-filtered, strict-grouped): NONE beats vote on a de-confounded basis; best are +1-task noise spikes that die under vote-residualization. Recommend Stage 2 GO (generator-independent ARC transition-EBM); also recommend recording in the Stage-1 artifact that vote's AUROC 0.9235 > probe's 0.8689 — the 'signal exists' framing should not imply the latent adds discriminative signal over vote, and noting the entry-level (not task-level) LOTO as a known-minor caveat.

reviewer_verdicts.best_alt_ranker_found: Best DE-CONFOUNDED: unbalanced ridge on raw latents, LOTO PCA-24 (lambda-insensitive 1..1000) = pass@2 0.4839 (15/31, +1 task over vote 0.4516; pass@1 0.3548 WORSE than vote 0.4194). Bootstrap-over-tasks CI95 [0.0, +0.0968], 33.9% of resamples <=0, and it is the max of 240 correlated sweep configs (pure post-hoc selection); several independent vote-free constructions (gold-centroid on per-task-centered-cosine, mean-diff on cosine, kNN-10 on cosine) all also cap at exactly 0.4839 — a consistent +1-task ceiling, single rescue f3e62deb voteR3->2; the deep headroom (c3202e5a R3/754-cand, be03b35f R7, 17cae0c1 R65) is never recovered vote-free. Best OVERALL (VOTE-CONFOUNDED): learned union [per-task-std latent PCA-16 + log-votes + q_mean + vote-share] = pass@2 0.5161 (+2 tasks; rescues c3202e5a R3->1 and f3e62deb R3->2, zero top-2 losses) — but CI95 [0.0, +0.1613] touches 0 (13.1% resamples <=0), it merely TIES the Stage-0 top-3-then-q_mean=0.5161 (the K=3 shortlist ceiling = vote pass@3), its latent increment over the no-latent control (votes+q+share=0.4839) is +1 task with paired CI [0.0, 0.0968] (33.9% <=0), and top-5-then-latent (0.4839) does not extend the shortlist beyond K=3. So the latent adds NO deployment capability beyond what Stage-0's scalar q_mean already gave. Vote-confounded => does not refute.
reviewer_verdicts.lens: STEELMAN-THE-OPPOSITE: swept ~270 OOF/LOTO constructions (5 latent variants {raw, cosine, per-task-std, per-task-center, per-task-center+cosine} x PCA k {8..64} x ridge lambda {1..1000} x balanced/unbalanced; committed-style logistic; parameter-free gold-centroid / mean-diff / kNN / 1NN-gold rankers; probe+votes+q_mean+vote-share feature unions; vote top-K shortlist re-ranks K=2..7; additive rank blends w={0.05..2}) to make the full 512-d latent beat vote pass@2=0.4516. It does not, on any de-confounded basis.
reviewer_verdicts.notes: RE-DERIVATION: all committed numbers reproduced EXACTLY from results/arc3_gap3_stage1_candidate_table.npz with independent code: VOTE 0.4194/0.4516, LATENT_PROBE 0.2903/0.4194, residual 0.0323/0.0645, HYBRID 0.4194/0.4516, Q_MEAN 0.2903/0.2903, oracle 0.6129 (19/31), within-task AUROC 0.8689, bootstrap point -0.0322 CI95 [-0.129, 0.0645] (same LCG). Reimplementing the committed LOTO PCA-24 + balanced-logistic pipeline from the raw z_mean reproduces the committed probe column at corr=1.0000 (p@1 0.2903 / p@2 0.4194) — no leak, OOF discipline verified (per-fold PCA basis and probe fit train-tasks-only; gold used for scoring only). MINOR FINDINGS (do not flip the verdict): (1) the committed balanced-logistic config is NOT the strongest latent construction — an unbalanced ridge reaches 0.4839 vs the committed 0.4194, so the artifact slightly understates the latent's best selection power; but even the sweep max is a non-significant +1 task (CI includes 0, best-of-240 selection bias) and fails the committed headroom gate (capture 0.0323/0.1613=0.20 < 0.30), so 'full_latent_does_not_beat_vote' stands for the strongest variant too. (2) The committed global-OLS residual control has negative slope (pearson(votes,probe)=-0.227), so its 0.0645 collapse partly reflects an anti-vote tilt rather than pure deconfounding; a fairer within-task vote-rank residual gives 0.1613 — still far below vote, conclusion unchanged. (3) Mean within-task spearman(votes,-probe)=0.36: the probe is only moderately vote-collinear, i.e. it carries some orthogonal signal, but that signal is worth at most +1 task at top-2 on n=31. STRUCTURE OF THE FAILURE: pass@K is within-task ranking, so the probe's AUROC 0.8689 (gold above ~87% of non-gold) is insufficient against 100-1000-candidate pools — gold sits at probe-rank 43-390 in the large-pool headroom tasks. This is precisely the gap a content/rule-aware Stage-2 transition-EBM targets; the positive control holds (oracle 0.6129 > vote 0.4516, real headroom exists). STAGE-2-RELEVANT ENGINEERING FINDING: vote+q_mean+vote_share+latent learned union = 0.5161 matches the best known confounded construction; vote_share (votes normalized within task) alone added over votes+q (0.4839 control vs 0.4516 vote) — worth carrying into the Stage-2 feature set as a baseline to beat. Caveat on all of the above: n=31 tasks; every delta discussed is 1-2 tasks; re-confirm at 400-task scale per the committed artifact's own caveat. Sweep artifacts: /tmp/stage1_partB_results.jsonl, /tmp/stage1_partB2.py, /tmp/stage1_partA.py (re-derivation), /tmp/stage1_post.py (summary). Data: /home/ianblenke/github.com/ianblenke/carnot/results/arc3_gap3_stage1_candidate_table.{npz,json}.

required_fixes: Amend results/arc3_gap3_stage1_latent_energy.json framing: the 'signal exists but does not convert' reading over-credits the latent. Record that vote's own within-task AUROC (0.9235) exceeds the probe's (0.8689) and the vote-orthogonal residual AUROC is 0.3176 (below chance) — the latent carries no incremental gold signal beyond vote; it is a partial vote shadow.

Correct the discrimination gate self-report: gates.discrimination_within_task_auroc_gt_0p70=True is based on a macro-AUROC inflated by 84.6% one-vote junk negatives; against votes>=5 hard negatives the probe AUROC is 0.6646 (FAILS 0.70) and pair-weighted is 0.7815. Add these variants to the artifact with a corrigendum note.

Document the vote-leak mechanism in the artifact and as a Stage-2 design constraint: per-candidate mean-pooling over `votes` augmentation latents injects vote count into the feature (corr(||z_mean||, log-votes) approx -0.41 Spearman / -0.80 raw-norm; approx -0.014 after centering). Stage-2 energies MUST be computed from grid content generator-independently with NO augmentation pooling.

Add a known-minor LOTO caveat: the split is leave-one-ENTRY-out and task f3e62deb contributes two entries (t29/t30) that sit in each other's training folds (direction favors the probe). Strict task-grouped LOTO reproduces identical probe numbers (pass@2=0.4194), so it is immaterial — but record it and use grouped LOTO in the 400-task re-confirmation.

Record the steelman ceiling: the committed balanced-logistic is not the strongest latent construction — unbalanced ridge / PCA-192 / probe24+knn25 rank-average reach pass@2=0.4839 (+1 task, CI95 [0.0,+0.0968] touching 0, post-hoc over 16-240 configs, and equal to vote's optimistic tie-break ceiling). The headline 'does not beat vote' holds at the sweep maximum too; state this so the artifact does not understate the latent's best selection power.

Note the residual-control caveat: the committed global-OLS vote-residualization is mildly anti-vote (pearson(votes,probe)=-0.227 slope tilt); a fairer within-task vote-rank residual gives pass@2=0.1613 and per-fold LOTO residualization gives identical 0.0323/0.0645 — all far below vote 0.4516, conclusion unchanged. Record both numbers.

Stage-2 protocol carry-forwards: (a) include probe24+knn25 within-task rank-average as a cheap latent steelman arm in the 400-task re-confirmation; (b) the baseline-to-beat is the no-latent votes+q_mean+vote_share union (pass@2 0.4839; 0.5161 with latent, tying Stage-0's top-3-then-q_mean shortlist ceiling) — vote_share is a cheap feature worth keeping; (c) n=31's CI upper edge (+0.0645) cannot exclude a small positive, so the negative must be re-confirmed at 400-task scale per the artifact's own caveat.
Non-blocking (cosmetic): bootstrap_pass2_delta_vs_vote.point should be -0.0323 (computed from exact pass rates) rather than -0.0322 (computed from pre-rounded values).
synthesis.summary: Five hostile reviewers (RE-DERIVATION, ALT-DECONFOUNDED-RANKERS, METRIC-INTERPRETATION, LEAK-AND-VALIDITY, STEELMAN-THE-OPPOSITE) independently re-derived the Stage-1 result from the committed 31-task / 8041-candidate NPZ and unanimously CONFIRM the negative: the full 512-d TRM latent (z_mean) does not beat majority vote as a selection energy. Every committed headline number reproduced exactly under all five lenses — vote pass@1/2 = 0.4194/0.4516 (13,14 of 31), LATENT_PROBE 0.2903/0.4194, Q_MEAN 0.2903/0.2903, vote-residualized probe 0.0323/0.0645, HYBRID 0.4194/0.4516, oracle ceiling 19/31 = 0.6129, within-task AUROC 0.8689 (18 scoreable tasks), bootstrap delta -0.0323 with CI95 [-0.129, +0.0645] (bit-exact LCG replication plus independent numpy B=10k-20k), headroom_capture -0.1996 — and the committed probe column itself re-fits from raw z_mean to max|diff| = 5.1e-7 (within-task rank agreement 1.0), confirming the LOTO PCA-24 + balanced-logistic implementation is leak-free (per-fold PCA basis and probe fit on train tasks only; held-out gold never trains its own ranker). An aggregate of roughly 300 alternative constructions across the panel (PCA k=4..192 probes; raw-512 logistic/ridge/LDA/Mahalanobis; kNN-{1,5,10,25} cosine+euclidean to train-gold; gold-centroid/mean-diff/softmin; RankNet pairwise; GBM stumps; per-task centering/standardization/cosine; feature unions; vote-shortlist re-ranks K=2..7; additive rank blends) produced ZERO de-confounded rankers beating vote 0.4516: the strongest vote-free single rankers TIE at 0.4516 and collapse to 0.03-0.29 under vote-residualization, and a handful of +1-task spikes reach 0.4839 (probe_k192, lda_k24, unbalanced ridge PCA-24, probe24+knn25 rank-average) but each is a single-task rescue (f3e62deb/t29, gold already at vote-rank 2), with bootstrap CI95 touching zero ([+0.0000, +0.0968]; 33-37% of resamples <=0), post-hoc selected from 16-240 correlated configs, and 0.4839 does not even exceed vote's own optimistic tie-break ceiling (0.4839; stable-sort puts the committed vote baseline at its PESSIMISTIC tie bound, biasing FOR the probe). The mechanism is now sharper than the committed artifact stated: vote's own within-task AUROC (0.9235) EXCEEDS the probe's (0.8689); the vote-orthogonal latent residual has AUROC 0.3176 (below chance); pair-weighted / hard-negative AUROC variants drop the probe to 0.7815 / 0.6646 (the votes>=5 variant FAILS the 0.70 discrimination gate the artifact reports as passed on the junk-inflated macro); and on the 5 vote-recoverable headroom tasks the probe ranks gold WORSE than vote on 4 of 5 (t2: 65 -> 328-442 of 599; t22: 3 -> 61-69 of 754). The latent is a strictly weaker, partially vote-collinear discriminator — per-candidate mean-pooling over `votes` augmentation latents leaks vote count into the feature (corr(||z_mean||, votes) approx -0.41 Spearman to -0.80 on log1p raw norm; approx -0.014 after centering) — not an independent signal that merely fails to convert. All validity findings are minor and conservative for the negative: the entry-level (not task-grouped) LOTO gives f3e62deb's two entries a sibling leak in the probe's favor, yet strict grouped LOTO is numerically identical (0.4194); 23/31 tasks have full 1001-augmentation vote coverage and 25%-thinned votes still hold ~0.460, so vote noise is immaterial; the bootstrap point -0.0322 vs exact -0.0323 is a pre-rounding cosmetic. The one Stage-2-relevant vote-CONFOUNDED positive: a learned union [per-task-std latent PCA-16 + log-votes + q_mean + vote_share] reaches 0.5161 (+2 tasks, zero top-2 losses) but merely ties Stage-0's top-3-then-q_mean shortlist ceiling, and its latent increment over the no-latent votes+q_mean+vote_share control (0.4839) is +1 task with CI touching zero — the latent adds no deployment capability beyond Stage-0's scalars. Verdict: NEGATIVE_CONFIRMED at n=31 (the CI upper edge +0.0645 supports "does not beat", not "provably worse"; re-confirm at the 400-task scale per the artifact's own caveat). Stage-2 GO: the positive control holds (oracle 0.6129 > vote 0.4516 — real headroom exists, gold is present-but-mis-voted), the negative was honestly established, and the failure anatomy (gold latent-buried deeper than vote-buried on the large-pool headroom tasks) is precisely the gap a content/rule-aware generator-independent ARC transition-EBM targets.

title: Adversarial-verify round over GAP-3 Stage-1 full-latent negative (GAP-3 design Section 4)
